 By Ira Winderman | iwinderman@sunsentinel.com | South Florida Sun Sentinel PUBLISHED: November 14, 2026 at 5:05 AM EST | UPDATED: November 14, 2026 at 9:30 AM EST Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... Q: I thought the loss of Kasparas Jakucionis was a player Miami would regret losing. And here comes Ryan Conwell in his rookie season trending upwards and dropping 20 points on Cleveland.  – Rodney. 
 A: And it certainly was both impressive and needed in Friday night’s victory over the Cavaliers . And Ryan Conwell very much has proven to be quite the second-round find. But the comparison to Kasparas Jakucionis also is somewhat apples to oranges, in that Kasparas is more of a point guard, while Ryan is more of an undersized scorer. The reality for the Heat, when healthy, is they probably need depth at point guard as much as at any position. Friday night’s victory over the Cavaliers showed as much, when Erik Spoelstra again barely could find rest for Davion Mitchell, with Dru Smith showing little in his cameo. So, yes, with Pelle Larsson and Klay Thompson out on Friday night, Ryan arrived as needed. But the lack of depth at point guard remains an overriding issue. The better comparison for Ryan might be whatever the Hornets wind up with from the first-round pick still due from the Heat from the Terry Rozier trade (top-14 protected in June, otherwise unprotected in 2028). Remember, Ryan was the result of the compensatory second-round pick the Heat received from the Hornets for not being made aware of the depth of the gambling investigation into Terry before he was dealt to the Heat.

 Q: Our two big guns decided to basically do it themselves. Now we can see what this team is about going forward.  – Carol. 
 A: Actually, they didn’t do it by themselves, with all due respect to Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo and their 37-point efforts Friday night against the Cavaliers. Better phrasing might be that their teammates put Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo in the best possible position to each score 37 on Friday night. That meant Davion Mitchell coming up with 17 assists and Ryan Conwell providing needed spacing. It was not a two-man effort, but rather at least a four-man composite.
 Q: Shame the Vice City jerseys are only promotional, those would have looked great on court against the Bucks. – Hector. 
 A: I would think there would be too many marketing issues if the Heat played with Vice City on their chests on Wednesday night, considering the money that patch sponsors and the uniform makers have paid for such product placement. And if allowed even on a one-time basis, what’s to stop the next team from featuring the Milwaukee Miller Lites or the Brooklyn Nathan’s Famous or the Magic Kingdoms. It would be a bit of a slippery slope.
